scope: Post hoc descriptive inspection of the fresh development predictions

units.H1: First relation in the ordered gold two-step path; exact mass ties receive half credit.
units.H2: Exact agreement with the indexed gold first fact; uncovered examples count as misses.
units.actual: Primary model's archived scores, using its natural gate.
units.forced_off: Direction-base scores on the identical feature rows and ordered shortlist; setting G=0 in H2 removes its token correction exactly.
units.uniform: Same graph, ordered shortlist, natural gate and frozen H2; uniform real-token weights.
units.counts: Raw graph-view-seed decision totals. A reversible graph supplies six primary views, other graphs two.
units.graph_means: Within each gate subgroup, average its available views within seed, then available seeds within graph, then graphs within stratum. Equal-three-stratum value requires a nonempty subgroup in all three strata.
units.comparisons: Changes compare actual to each control on the same decision. Rescued = control wrong, actual correct; lost = control correct, actual wrong.
units.examples: First qualifying primary decision by view order original/paraphrase/q0/q1/q2/q3, graph ID, seed. Missing examples have zero qualifying decisions.
